question: Should `submitText` become a permanent shared `PluginInteractiveHandlerResult` capability, with Discord and Telegram implementing the same source-bound submission semantics?
rationale: This is a new public Plugin SDK capability rather than a mechanical correction to an established Discord contract, so tests cannot decide whether the API and its long-term cross-channel semantics should be supported.

options.title: Approve shared capability
options.body: Accept the additive shared result after live Discord proof confirms authorization, context preservation, and exact-once delivery.

options.title: Keep transport-specific contracts
options.body: Retain Telegram's existing result and redesign Discord support without promising a shared cross-channel SDK field.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Close or defer the PR if generic plugin-authored inbound text is not a product surface OpenClaw wants to maintain.

recommendation.title: Approve shared capability
recommendation.body: Accept the additive shared result after live Discord proof confirms authorization, context preservation, and exact-once delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only evidence-backed available routing candidate with repository-level ownership standing for a permanent public SDK decision.
